title: The Book of Cabbage
description: An open antique book rests in a puddle of yellow liquid, its pages formed from large cabbage leaves with a prominent yellow letter 'Y' in the center. Surrounding the book are whole and halved cabbages in shades of green and purple, set against a background of oversized cabbage leaves under a smoky purple haze.
prompt: A surreal still life painting featuring an ancient open book whose pages are giant cabbage leaves, with a large glowing yellow letter Y growing from the center page. The book sits in a puddle of golden liquid, surrounded by whole and cut cabbages in green and purple. Oversized cabbage leaves fill the background, with faint handwritten script floating in a smoky purple mist above. Detailed, realistic textures with fantastical elements.
